summary: A two-part synthesizer firmware with six engines and a browser editor, meant for playing sounds rather than sequencing. It started as a fork of Melodee.
features: Prophet, FM6, CZ-1, JUNO-106, HYDRA and PPG engines
Two parts played by MIDI channel, split or layered
Arpeggiator, chords, strum, scales and microtonal tuning
384 user sound slots, favourites and SysEx import and export
USB, TRS-in and Bluetooth MIDI; stereo USB audio at 44.1 kHz
No sequencer or multitrack recording; can overwrite Melodee data
